app.name: NISAR Pulse
app.tagline: What the NISAR radar measured, with its uncertainty and its limits

offline.title: Server unreachable
offline.body: The NISAR Pulse server does not answer at this address. Check that it is running, then try again.

contract.title: Response rejected
contract.body: The server sent data that does not match the interface contract. It is not shown, so that no unchecked number appears.

unexpected.title: Unexpected error
unexpected.body: An unexpected error prevents this data from being shown. Try again; if it comes back, report it to the team.

errors.untranslated: Text not available in this language ({{id}})

cases.lede: Events where NISAR measured the ground, compared with an independent reference where one exists.
cases.draftNote: These case studies are drafts: their NISAR values are not measured yet. Nothing here is a result.

agreement.partial: Partly agrees: gap between 2σ and 4σ combined
agreement.pending: Compared once the NISAR value is measured

case.draftBand: This case is not a result: its NISAR values are not measured yet.
case.limits: What the radar cannot tell here

map.noRaster: No radar map for this case yet: only the study area and the event point are drawn.

map.imageFailed: The radar image could not be loaded from the server.

sign.positive_away_from_satellite: positive values (red end): the ground moves away from the satellite
